// Chokepoint fixture (stdout-sink, PLUG-13): a bin/lib module that prints
// straight to the process's stdout. Under the MCP server each of these lines
// lands in the JSON-RPC stream and the client drops the connection — the rule
// must flag all three forms (print through out() from bin/lib/output-sink.ts).
export function reportWritten(path: string, ok: boolean): void {
  process.stdout.write(`pensmith plan: wrote PLAN.md to ${path}\n`);
  console.log('pensmith plan: done');
  (ok ? process.stdout : process.stderr).write('pensmith plan: next is write\n');
}
